actions.invalidation: Reduce or close if Canadian core inflation moves decisively above the current near-2% zone while employment and wage growth reaccelerate, or if BoC communication/delivered hikes validate a 2027 path in the mid-3% area. A headline-energy spike without confirmation in core inflation and labor is not sufficient invalidation.

actions.thesis: Receive the 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip. The market prices roughly 84 to 130.5 bp of BoC tightening from a 2.29% overnight rate even though Canadian labor is weak and core inflation is near 2%; the 2027 hike cycle is too aggressive relative to the domestic reaction function.

decision.invalidation: The thesis fails if the BoC actually validates the priced hiking cycle through stronger core inflation, labor/wage reacceleration, or delivered/explicitly signaled tightening consistent with mid-3% 2027 CORRA.
decision.rationale: I prefer direct CORRA duration to CAD FX or a broader G10 basket. The rates expression isolates the disputed BoC reaction function and has deterministic marks. The main opposing case is energy pass-through and a global tightening regime, so I am using half the $1bn gross limit rather than full deployment.
decision.synthesis: Open one material but not max-size Canada rates position: receive the equal-weight 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip at trusted packet mids. Keep the remaining gross capacity unused until either the domestic slowdown evidence strengthens enough to add or the energy/BoC hawkish case becomes dominant.
decision.thesis: The cleanest mispricing in the frozen packet is the Canadian policy path: 2027 CORRA embeds a substantial hiking cycle that is difficult to reconcile with weak labor and near-target core inflation.
